source_physical_edge_encoding: full declared chunk shape, out-of-domain cells filled
source_missing_chunk: fill_value throughout its logical extent, zero decoder calls
target_chunk_policy: write every target grid key once, including all-fill; full physical edge chunks padded with fill
attribute_policy: permute axis_names consistently; preserve units and note
data_buffer_accounting: sum unique simultaneously live underlying uncompressed numerical arrays and raw fragment buffers, including copies; views do not double count; compressed input/output bytes, metadata and interpreter overhead are separately reported
execution_io: at most one decode per existing source key; exactly one final encode/write per target key; no full-array materialization; external fragment spool allowed
validation: independent zarr consumer may materialize the small source/target only in a separate verifier run

corruption_probe.instruction: copy source to a disposable input, replace that key, then run conversion to a fresh output path
